note: Synthetic. A business analyst answers two questions and replies to the bank follow-up after each in a way that covers its point; the feedback should cover each answer and its reply together, in words.

answers.answer: I would write down each change with who asked for it, show what it pushes out of the sprint, and agree with the stakeholder which change waits for the next one.

followUp.answer: Then I would ask what it replaces. The product owner decides what drops out of this sprint, and I would note the swap in the sprint notes so the team sees why.

answers.answer: I would tell my manager what is late, why, the new date I can keep and what would help me finish sooner, in a short message.

followUp.answer: The same day I see the risk, not the day before the deadline, so my manager still has time to move people or change the plan.
